models.name: LogisticRegression (Deployed)
models.justification: Optimal serverless fit: instantaneous cold start (<2ms), tiny 2KB size, full occlusion explainability.

models.name: SVM (RBF)
models.justification: Lower AUC (-0.038) and non-linear kernel slows inference.

models.name: RandomForest (100 trees)
models.justification: Large bundle footprint (245 KB), 12x slower inference, no AUC advantage.

models.name: GradientBoosting
models.justification: Overfits small cohort; lower AUC (-0.053) with higher complexity.

models.name: KNN (k=5)
models.justification: Poor discrimination in tabular demographic feature space.
